steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Stun|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

attacks.name: Fimbuldraugr
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.
|!wild| |!hit| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild| or |!block| results to a Blank.

attacks.name: Brandrheid Undrsigr
steps: Add dice to this attack roll equal to the defender's |!threat|.
|!wild| |!failure| |!failure| |*Clumsy Warrior|: After this attack is resolved, the defender suffers 3 |!damage| and this character gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

superPowers.name: Strike One for Volstagg!
superPowers.body: This character may immediately make an attack with a |!power| cost of 0 targeting an enemy character within |!range| 2. After that attack is resolved, if the attack roll contains any |!failure| results, this character suffers 1 |!damage|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: My Steel Shall Strike for Thee
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, this character may use this superpower. If the attacker is within |!range| 3, this character may make a |*Fimbuldraugr| attack targeting it.

superPowers.name: Grim Resolve
superPowers.body: When this character suffers |!damage| from an enemy attack, after that attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!range_small| Toward the attacker. If it does, after that Advance is resolved, it may remove 1 |!damage| from itself.

superPowers.name: Asgardian
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.
